source_text:
ταύτας γὰρ τὰς πλάνας ἃς κατὰ μέρος
συνερτήσατο ὁ διάβολος ἀφιστῶν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἡρέμα τὴν ἑαυτοῦ προσκύνησιν
ἀντεισάγων, ἵν' ὅταν μετὰ ταῦτα ἔλθῃ, προητοιμασμένα εὑρηκώς, καὶ
πεπλανημένους τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ ἐκτὸς ὄντας τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς βοηθείας, εὐχερῶς
ἑαυτῷ δόξῃ κατορθοῦν τὸ σπουδαζόμενον, τοῦτ' ἔστι τὸ προσκυνηθῆναι αὐτὸν παρὰ
πάντων ἀνθρώπων. 334, col 2 ὡς γὰρ ὑποσκευὴ ἁψῖδος, οὕτως αἱ αἱρέσεις αἵ τε παρ'
Ἕλλησι καὶ αἱ παρὰ τοῖς Χριστιανοῖς τῷ διαβόλῳ. ὥσπερ δὲ ἁψῖδος σφιγγείσης καὶ
λαβούσης τὴν οἰκείαν κατασκευὴν ἡ ὑποσκευὴ αἴρεται, μένει δὲ μόνη ἡ ἁψῖς στερρά,
οὕτως ὁ διάβολος τὰς αἱρέσεις τὰς πολλὰς καὶ τὰς τῆς πλάνης ὁδοὺς ἀντὶ ὑποσκευῆς
ὑπέθηκεν, ὥσπερ ἁψῖδα μεγίστην τὴν ἑαυτοῦ προσκύνησιν προκατασκευάζων, ἵν'
ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐκδικῶν πάσας τὰς αἱρέσεις, καὶ αὐτὸς καταργῇ γυμνὴν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ
προσκύνησιν εἰσάγων ἀνθρώπους. 2 Thess 2,4 Κατὰ μίμησιν τοῦ σωτῆρος ἔρχεται ὁ
σατανᾶς ἐν ἀνθρώπῳ ὁλοκλήρῳ. 2 Thess 2,6®8a Κατέχει καὶ κωλύει τοῦ ἀνόμου τὴν
παρουσίαν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον. ἐπειδὰν οὖν, φησί, τοῦτο διὰ τὴν τῶν ἀνθρώπων
κακίαν ἐκ μέσου γένηται καὶ ἀποστῇ, τὸ τηνικαῦτα χώραν ἕξει ὁ ἄνομος
ἀποκαλυφθῆναι καὶ ἐπαναστῆναι μηδενὸς κωλύοντος. ἔφη δὲ τοῦτο, ὅτι καὶ ἀρχὴν
ἤδη εἴληφε τὸ μυστήριον τῆς ἀνομίας, ἐπειδὴ κατὰ τοὺς χρόνους τοὺς ἀποστολικοὺς
καὶ σχίσματα καὶ αἱρέσεις γεγόνασιν, καὶ ἔκτοτε τὴν ἀπιστίαν τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὁ
διάβολος διεπράττετο. τὸ γὰρ μυστήριον ἤδη ἐνεργεῖται τῆς ἀσεβείας. καὶ γὰρ
Μανιχαῖοι ἤδη εἶπον τὸν διάβολον θεὸν εἶναι τοῦ νόμου, καὶ Μαρκίων εἶπεν οὐ τὸν
πατέρα εἶναι τοῦ Χριστοῦ τὸν θεὸν τοῦ νόμου καὶ τὸν πάντων μείζονα λέγουσί τινες
335 σέβειν. λέγει δὲ καὶ Χριστὸν ἑαυτὸν εἶναι ὁ Μάνης, καὶ τὸν παράκλητον ἑαυτὸν
εἶναι. μόνον τὸ κατέχον ἄρτι ἕως ἐκ μέσου γένηται, καὶ τότε ἀποκαλυφθήσεται ὁ
ἄνομος. καὶ κατέχει καὶ κωλύει τοῦ ἀνόμου τὴν παρουσίαν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, ὡς
καὶ ἤδη εἶπεν. καὶ νῦν τὸ κατέχον οἴδατε. 334, col 2. Τὸ κατέχον φησὶ τὴν τοῦ ἁγίου
πνεύματος χάριν.
thought_title: How error prepares worship and why the end waits
orientation: Severian is explaining how the devil uses error to prepare his own worship and how the Holy Spirit holds off the man of lawlessness until the appointed time.
pass_a_gloss: For these errors which the devil fitted together in part, while separating men from God and quietly bringing in his own worship in its place, in order that when he comes after these things, having found things made ready beforehand, and having found men led astray and standing outside the help of God, he may with ease suppose that he brings to success for himself the thing he labors for, that is for him to be worshipped by all men. For as scaffolding for an arch, so are the heresies both among Greeks and among Christians for the devil. And as when an arch is drawn tight and takes its proper building the scaffolding is taken away, and the arch alone remains firm, so the devil placed underneath the many heresies and the roads of error in place of scaffolding, building beforehand his own worship as a greatest arch, in order that when he comes he may avenge all heresies, and may himself abolish them, bringing in for men his own worship bare. In imitation of the savior Satan comes in a complete man. Holy Spirit restrains and hinders the coming of the man of lawlessness. Whenever then, he says, this through the wickedness of men becomes out of the midst and departs, at that time the man of lawlessness will have place to be uncovered and to rise up with no one hindering. And he said this, because the mystery of lawlessness already has taken a beginning, since in the apostolic times both schisms and heresies have come to be, and from that time the devil was accomplishing the unbelief of men. For the mystery of impiety already is at work. For even Manichaeans already said the devil is god of the law, and Marcion said the god of the law is not the father of Christ, and some say they revere the one greater than all. And Mani says he himself is Christ, and he himself is the advocate. Only the restrainer for now until it becomes out of the midst, and then the man of lawlessness will be uncovered. And Holy Spirit restrains and hinders the coming of the man of lawlessness, as he also already said. And now you know the restrainer. By the restrainer he means the grace of Holy Spirit.

Brief fixes restrainer for the neuter participle acting as a power
Brief fixes heresy for αἵρεσις, plural here

pass_b_english: Severian says the devil pieced these errors together bit by bit. He drew people away from God. He slipped in his own worship little by little. He did this so that when he comes afterward he will find everything prepared. He will find people deceived and cut off from God's help. Then he will easily seem to gain what he strives for. That is to be worshiped by all people.

The heresies among the Greeks and the heresies among Christians serve the devil like scaffolding for an arch. When an arch is drawn tight and takes its proper shape, the scaffolding is removed. The arch alone stands firm. In the same way the devil has laid down the many heresies and the roads of error as scaffolding. He is building his own worship in advance like a very great arch. When he comes he will pass judgment on every heresy. He will abolish them himself. He will lead people to his own bare worship. For Satan comes in a complete man, in imitation of the Savior.

The Holy Spirit restrains and holds back the coming of the man of lawlessness. Paul says that when the restrainer is taken out of the way because of human wickedness and departs, then the man of lawlessness will have room to be revealed and to rise up with no one stopping him. Paul said that the mystery of lawlessness has already begun, because in the apostolic age schisms and heresies had already appeared. Since then the devil has been working unbelief among people. For the mystery of impiety is already at work. The Manichaeans already said the devil is the god of the law. Marcion said the god of the law is not the Father of Christ. Some say they worship one greater than all. And Mani calls himself Christ. He calls himself the Advocate.

Only the restrainer remains for now until he is taken out of the way, and then the man of lawlessness will be revealed (2 Thessalonians 2:7-8). The Holy Spirit restrains and holds back the coming of the man of lawlessness, as Paul has already said. And now you know the restrainer (2 Thessalonians 2:6). By the restrainer, Severian says, Paul means the grace of the Holy Spirit.
notes: Column figures 334 col 2 and 335 omitted as non textual. The clause with τῆς ἀσεβείας differs from τῆς ἀνομίας and is glossed as written.

problems.why: ὅτι introduces the content of what Paul said ('that'), while ἐπειδὴ ('because') explains why he said it; English turns ὅτι into 'because' and drops ἐπειδὴ.
problems.fix: Paul said that the mystery of lawlessness has already begun because in the apostolic age schisms and heresies had already appeared.
problems.ruling: ἔφη τοῦτο ὅτι gives content; ἐπειδὴ gives reason (apostolic schisms). English uses 'because' for ὅτι and drops ἐπειδὴ's causal link.
